standard_map_rules: Letters are columns; numbers are rows; north means smaller row number.
Place every witness once, different row and column for every witness.
Use printed witnesses and visible map features only.
Companion is interview lead, not culprit.
Keep every final witness position after verdict.
Use case-specific standable/blocked objects and original walls/doorways.
ROOM extraction excludes ZONES; do not infer usability from gray shading.

truth_and_reveal_order: The intake envelope came from internal Academy stock, with no courier or outside delivery.
Exactly four controlled records carry the same plain 0. The Look-Twice file was routed but not marked.
017 is the current Trophy Hall reference; 071 is an older linked Heritage/intake archive file, not a typo.
The local cases are real, with ordinary resolutions. A room companion is not guilty merely by placement.
Bibi recognizes the old form, then the photograph and her handwriting; she does not know the zero meaning or missing rule before evidence supplies it.
Bibi wrote archive route notes as a trainee. The routing log and matching handwriting confirm this only at the finale.
The old route performs MATCH / ROUTE / VERIFY; CASE CREATION: NONE. It cannot create cases, choose a suspect, investigate, solve cases or choose the reader’s name.
There are five active field detectives and one archive mentor, Bibi. The reader earns field position06.
Book1 Room Zero closes. Archive File001 opens a new question with a triangular symbol, a cut-out person and RETURN BEFORE THE FIRST MEETING. It does not explain Book1 through a villain.
